tip: This preset changes the format of all the built-in modules to show their segment in brackets instead of using the default Starship wording ("via", "on", etc.).

tip: This preset changes the symbols for each module to use Nerd Font symbols.

tip: This preset does not show icons if the toolset is not found.

next.name: no-nerd-font
tip: This preset changes the symbols for several modules so that no Nerd Font symbols are used anywhere in the prompt.

next.name: no-runtime-versions

next.name: pastel-powerline
tip: This preset is inspired by M365Princess.

next.name: plain-text-symbols
tip: This preset changes the symbols for each module into plain text.
Great if you don't have access to Unicode.
